name: Naval Support Activity Singapore
tagline: Shore support for the Navy's logistics hub in Southeast Asia, with families in international schools.
coords_source: approximate point at Sembawang, from public maps
_note: Written on 2026-11-21 by scripts/guides/write_missed_guides.py from the official pages named in each section. Not in the first installation list; added after the missed-bases check.

data.Major command: Commander, Task Force 73 / Logistics Group Western Pacific

source.label: Military OneSource, NSA Singapore major units

sections.title: Housing
data: The directory mentions government-leased housing at Sembawang, with a limit of two pets per home. Ask your sponsor how housing is assigned and what is available when you arrive.

sections.title: Schools
data: There is no DoDEA school in Singapore. Families can enroll children in Singapore's international schools, but a U.S. military connection does not guarantee a place: apply early. Programs for special needs are very limited.

intro: An overseas move has extra steps. Start these before you leave.

steps.title: Request a sponsor
steps.text: Through your gaining command; the sponsor helps with schools, pet import and temporary lodging.

steps.title: Start pet import early
steps.text: Most pets are quarantined at least 10 days, quarantine space books up from June to August, and some breeds cannot be imported.

steps.title: Get passports
steps.text: Every member and family member needs a valid passport before travel.
